text:
emily: Partner asked for a clear runbook on provisional forecasts vs final ledger. they want nightly pushes + a one-click CSV export so finance can reconcile before month close.
javier: Short version: provisional = estimator (may change); ledger = authoritative final rows post-finalization window. we should make both available but label them loudly.
rachel: proposal: nightly webhook for provisional with confidence score, plus a daily CSV export endpoint. include a footer in CSV: 'provisional - not final; disputes accepted within 7 days of ledger finalization'.
ops-bot: Created ticket MP-5201 assigned to rachel: partner-preview-csv + webhook.
partner-liaison: partners also want a 'why changed' field when a row mutates (small enum: BACKFILL, DEDUP, PRICE_ADJUST, MANUAL_ADJ). useful for automated reconciliation.
emily: agree. add a change_reason and original_report_ts to any mutated row in the provisional feed.
security: ensure HMAC-SHA256 signature header on webhooks and include a key rotation header (x-key-id). docs should show verification example.
javier: minor technical: estimator confidence = 1 - min(0.5, backfill_rate * 0.6) as a quick heuristic; we can refine later. label confidence in [0.0-1.0].
partner-liaison: also ask for a ratecap_hint so partners can degrade client-side sampling to avoid surprise overages. e.g., {"reduce_by_pct": 20}.
rachel: CSV format proposal (pipe-separated in header for clarity) and columns: period_start|period_end|customer_id|sku|usage_units|unit_price_cents|provisional_amount_cents|ledger_row_id|change_reason|confidence|exported_at_utc
emily: dispute flow: partner opens ticket referencing ledger_row_id within 7 days of ledger finalization. if ingestion bug confirmed we issue credit; provisional previews don't trigger auto-credit.
partner-liaison: partners asked about timezone issues. confirm: all timestamps normalized to UTC and hour-buckets include events with timestamp >= hour_start and < hour_end. document edge-case rule.
ops-bot: Reminder: schedule partner walkthrough demo on Thu 11:00 PT.
emily: action items: rachel -> spec + sample CSV; javier -> estimator confidence impl + explainers; security -> webhook signing docs; partner-liaison -> collect partner opt-ins for throttling. i'll consolidate and share with partner before demo. :white_check_mark:
